decision: Footage: *REEL selection is hardtop print-shop + Jul 16 fitment (no scanning); scanning is DJI_20250715210710_0030 (Osmo Pocket 3, Epsilon dump); removal action from FX30636 (FX3A, S-Log3)

decision: Base scan = Full Car Top Down (14,999,997 tris); rear-trim-removed state = Hardtop Mounting Full Car (18,547,676 tris), same Artec frame
why: Footage car is top-down with roll hoop; voxel overlap test: htm 89% within 20-40 mm of topdown (same frame), separate state STLs only 29-45% (different frames)

decision: All MR2 scans rigidly re-oriented once (tools/align.py, match/align.json: PCA long axis -> +Y, levelled on 4 tyre contact patches, 3.3 deg tilt removed); every state goes through the same transform + prep --like topdown.json
why: ive crop/prep assume the car is axis-aligned; raw Artec export is diagonal and tilted. One shared transform keeps all states registered

decision: Rear End trunk open scan (7,000,064 tris) registered onto topdown with FPFH+RANSAC then point-to-plane ICP (tools/register.py): 3.2 mm rms, overlap 31% (lid + engine bay differ)
why: It is in a 2024 Artec frame; overlay render shows bumper, tail lights, wheel coincident - only the open engine lid differs, so it is a valid 'lid open' state for the FX30636 removal shot

decision: FX3A S-Log3 graded with a generated LUT (tools/slog3_lut.py: Sony S-Log3 decode, S-Gamut3.Cine->709, Hable, exp 1.6); FX clips are landscape 3840x2160 -> 9:16 crop window
why: XML sidecars say s-log3-cine; ive only tonemaps HLG. Contact sheets had centre-cropped the landscape frames, so crop placement must be chosen per shot

decision: Music: original MR2 track starts at 13.898 s (bar downbeat, 4 beats before the drop); 1:1 cut on the drop at 16.04 s (video 2.141 s); grid t0 0.5145 + 0.53535 n (112.1 BPM, onset LS fit 9.8 ms rms)
why: Track is full-energy from 0 s with a half-beat dip then the B-section hit at 16.04 s (mids/highs step up); kick band too weak to fit (10/68), so broadband onsets used. Lesson: start 2-4 hits before the drop, transformation ON the drop; reel ends with the music (~37 s)

decision: Cut A = DJI_0030 @ 74.0 s (frame 1774) to Full Car Top Down; silhouette solve (tools/silsolve.py, GrabCut car mask, ignore boxes on roll hoop/mirror/wheel), focal locked 22 mm (20.25 mm sensor-width model), chamfer 4.1/5.4 px @600w, IoU 0.880
why: Osmo Pocket 3 lens: free solve went to 25.7 mm but locked 22 mm scores better (10.67 vs 11.77), so the free search sat in a local minimum. Onion: A-pillars, windshield, mirrors, headlight and bumper corner coincide

decision: No hood-scoop composite at cut A (stock-hood Top Down scan used as captured)
why: Footage hood has the duct scoops; the Kouki+Undertray splice (ICP 3.6 mm) shifted headlight edges and left a seam rectangle. Lesson 240SX: splice only the smallest changed zone - here even that broke the 1:1 alignment

decision: Cut B = DJI_0030 @ 56.0 s (frame 1343, rear view while the crew scans the deck) -> Full Car Top Down; camB = silhouette (hand-traced outline) + 2 plate-recess landmarks, focal 22 mm, IoU 0.83
why: FX30636/DJI_0035 removal frames are landscape close-ups with no rigid full-car silhouette (hardtop in hands, lid only) - silhouette-only solves flipped to a front view; the 56 s rear frame shows tail light, louvres, plate and flank, and the plate points stop the front/back ambiguity. Onion: flank, tail-light arc, lid louvres and plate recess coincide; bumper bottom ~3% short

decision: Track start corrected to 12.8276 s (beat n=23, 6 beats before the n=29 hit at 16.04 s) - video 3.21 s IRL before cut A
why: Matches the approved 240SX opening (3.07 s IRL then 1:1 on the drop); 6 beats keeps the hook inside the 3 s rule-of-thumb while letting the scanner action read. Video runs to the end of the music (~24.5 s)

decision: Story: front scanning (IRL) -> 1:1 scan A -> crew lifts the hardtop (FX30636) -> rear scanning (IRL) -> 1:1 scan B -> rear-end lid-open state, lid explodes and spins -> x-ray reassembly -> listing

decision: Cuts on accents with varied holds: 6,6,6,4,4,8,6 beats (3.2/3.2/3.2/2.1/2.1/4.3/3.2 s), web lands on n=63 (strongest kick in the track)
